power.jaymospowers.gravity.desc: Take the weight out of things, or pile it on. Lift creatures, float yourself, pull and crush.
power.jaymospowers.gravity.key.ability_1: Hold: Lift a creature, or tear a chunk from a block. Right click: choke, then slam. Left click: push or throw. Sneak as you let go: it falls sideways, the way you look
power.jaymospowers.gravity.key.ability_2: Gravity Well: a bubble of pressure bursts out around you; everything that touches it is weighed down, to its knees. Sneak: everything around falls sideways, out into the walls
power.jaymospowers.gravity.key.ability_3: Tap: Weightless (jump high, fall slow, no fall damage). Hold: ride a slab of rock while it's held; fully mastered, it stays up until %3$s again (on it again: the same board). Sneak while Weightless: fall forward, the way you look
power.jaymospowers.gravity.key.ability_4: Tap: everything around you is forced to its knees (after %2$s, it launches you high too). Hold, then let go: a Gravity Wave rolls out the way you look, throwing what it passes and carving up the ground. While %1$s holds a creature: Inversion, it's yanked in for a gut punch that sends it flying, bleeding inside and heavily slowed. Sneak + %4$s: Comet Ram, you wrap yourself in gravity and ram forward the way you look, carrying every creature in your path ahead of you and slamming them down where it ends (a wall, the ground, or its end); with nothing to take the blow, a wall hurts you
power.jaymospowers.gravity.key.ultimate: Meteor: hold to gather, let go to call it down where you aim
message.jaymospowers.gravity_ascend.0: Everything you drop falls a little further.
message.jaymospowers.gravity_ascend.1: The ground feels very far below you now.
message.jaymospowers.gravity_cure_hint: For a moment, something else carries the weight...
power.jaymospowers.gravity.key.starter: Hold: Lift (weightless where you point). Small things drift toward you; you jump a little higher
power.jaymospowers.gravity.key.ability_1: Hold: Lift or tear a chunk. Right click: choke, then slam. Left click: push or throw. Let go: it's driven into the ground
Hold: Lift, tear a chunk, or take a block from your orbit. Right click: choke, then slam. Left click: push or throw. Let go: it's driven into the ground
power.jaymospowers.gravity.key.ability_3: Tap: Weightless. Hold: ride a slab of rock (%3$s again to step off; on it again: the same board). Sneak while Weightless: fall forward

While %1$s holds a creature: Inversion, a gut punch that bleeds it inside. Singularity: a black hole where you aim
Skyfall: everything around falls up, then slams down
power.jaymospowers.gravity.key.mode: Immense Field (once the Well is yours): a dome of heavy gravity where you aim, for a minute. Everyone in it but you is slowed and falls fast; a Z Fighter trains twice as fast in it, and each minute one trains there brings you mastery. %5$s again takes it down
power.jaymospowers.gravity.key.mode.name: Immense Field
message.jaymospowers.gravity.field: Immense Field: the air grows heavy.
message.jaymospowers.gravity.field_wait: The Immense Field returns in %s s.
message.jaymospowers.gravity.field_spar: Shadowboxing beside a partner under your own weight: you train faster.
message.jaymospowers.gravity.field_starv: Too hungry to hold the Immense Field.
